classFeature.name: Spellcasting
entries: You have learned to channel the magical essence of nature to cast spells. See {@book chapter 7|XPHB|7} for the rules on spellcasting. The information below details how you use those rules with Demon Hunter spells, which appear in the {@filter Demon Hunter spell list|spells|class=Demon Hunter (wow:s)} later in the class's description.

entries.name: Spell Slots
entries: The Demon Hunter Features table shows how many spell slots you have to cast your level 1+ spells. You regain all expended slots when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Prepared Spells of Level 1+
entries: You prepare the list of level 1+ spells that are available for you to cast with this feature. To start, choose two {@filter level 1 Demon Hunter spells|spells|class=Demon Hunter (wow:s)|level=1}. {@spell Cure Wounds|XPHB} and {@spell Ensnaring Strike|XPHB} are recommended.

The number of spells on your list increases as you gain Demon Hunter levels, as shown in the Prepared Spells column of the Demon Hunter Features table. Whenever that number increases, choose additional Demon Hunter spells until the number of spells on your list matches the number in the Demon Hunter Features table. The chosen spells must be of a level for which you have spell slots. For example, if you're a level 5 Demon Hunter, your list of prepared spells can include six Demon Hunter spells of level 1 or 2 in any combination.

If another Demon Hunter feature gives you spells that you always have prepared, those spells don't count against the number of spells you can prepare with this feature, but those spells otherwise count as Demon Hunter spells for you.

entries.name: Changing Your Prepared Spells
entries: Whenever you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you can replace one spell on your list with another Demon Hunter spell for which you have spell slots.

entries.name: Spellcasting Ability
entries: Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for your Demon Hunter spells.

entries.name: Spellcasting Focus
entries: You can use an {@item Arcane Focus|XPHB} (not a {@item Druidic Focus|XPHB}) as a {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB} for your Demon Hunter spells.

classFeature.name: Favored Enemy
entries: You always have the {@spell Hunter's Mark|XPHB} spell prepared. You can cast it twice without expending a spell slot, and you regain all expended uses of this ability when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.
The number of times you can cast the spell without a spell slot increases when you reach certain Demon Hunter levels, as shown in the Favored Enemy column of the Demon Hunter Features table.

classFeature.name: Fighting Style
entries: You gain a {@filter Fighting Style feat|feats|category=FS} of your choice. Instead of choosing one of those feats, you can choose the option below.

classFeature.name: Demon Hunter Specialization
entries: You gain a Demon Hunter Specialization of your choice. For the rest of your career, you gain each of your specialization's features that are of your Demon Hunter level or lower.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: You gain the {@feat Ability Score Improvement|XPHB} feat or another {@5etools feat|feats.html} of your choice for which you qualify. You gain this feature again at Demon Hunter levels 8, 12, and 16.

entries: You learn two {@filter Warlock cantrips|spells|level=0|class=warlock} of your choice. {@spell Chill Touch|XPHB} and {@spell Mind Sliver|XPHB} are recommended. The chosen cantrips count as Demon Hunter spells for you, and Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for them. Whenever you gain a Demon Hunter level, you can replace one of these cantrips with another Warlock cantrip.

entries.name: Demon Hunter
entries: {@i Embrace the Magic of Demons to Fight Fire with Fire}

Most Demon Hunters joined Illidan on Outland as he marshaled his forces to battle the Burning Legion. You might have followed a different path, inspired by Illidan rather than directly trained by him, but the result is the same: You have embraced the magic of the Burning Legion with the singular goal of defeating it on Azeroth and every other world.

entries.name: Hero Classes
entries: Three of the World of Warcraft classes—{@class Death Knight|WarcraftStreamlined}, {@class Demon Hunter|WarcraftStreamlined}, and {@class Evoker|WarcraftStreamlined}—are hero classes, meaning that they are typically available only to characters starting at level 3 or higher. In the story of World of Warcraft, characters with these classes are already experienced and powerful adventurers by the time they enter the game.

entries.name: Playing a Demon Hunter
entries: Demon hunter is a hero class, which means you typically must start play at level 3 or higher (see the "Hero Classes" sidebar earlier in this chapter).
All demon hunters in World of Warcraft lore are elves (blood elves, night elves, or void elves), so check with your DM before playing a demon hunter of another species.
As a Demon Hunter, you can choose one of three specializations: Devourer, Havoc, or Vengeance.

entries.name: Havoc Specialization
entries: With the havoc specialization, you are a fierce melee combatant who masters the destructive power of fel magic. The following choices will help you focus on this specialization:

entries.name: Level 1
entries: Choose {@item Handaxe|XPHB|Handaxes}, {@item Scimitar|XPHB|Scimitars}, or {@item Shortsword|XPHB|Shortswords} for your Weapon Mastery feature. Choose {@feat Two-Weapon Fighting|XPHB} for a Fighting Style feat.

entries.name: Feats
entries: Consider the following feats at higher levels: {@feat Charger|XPHB}, {@feat Dual Wielder|XPHB}, {@feat Mage Slayer|XPHB}, and {@feat Slasher|XPHB}.

entries.name: Level 1
entries: Choose {@item Handaxe|XPHB|Handaxes}, {@item Scimitar|XPHB|Scimitars}, or {@item Shortsword|XPHB|Shortswords} for your Weapon Mastery feature. Choose the {@feat Void Warrior|WarcraftStreamlined} option instead of a Fighting Style feat, and choose {@spell Chill Touch|XPHB} and {@spell Mind Sliver|XPHB} as your cantrips.

entries.name: Feats
entries: Consider the following feats at higher levels: {@feat Defensive Duelist|XPHB}, {@feat Mage Slayer|XPHB}, {@feat Shadow-Touched|XPHB}, {@feat Slasher|XPHB}, {@feat Speedy|XPHB}, and {@feat Spell Sniper|XPHB}.

entries.name: Level 1
entries: Choose {@item Battleaxe|XPHB|Battleaxes} or {@item Longsword|XPHB|Longswords} for your Weapon Mastery feature. Choose {@feat Interception|XPHB} as your Fighting Style feat.

entries.name: Feats
entries: Consider the following feats at higher levels: {@feat Charger|XPHB}, {@feat Durable|XPHB}, {@feat Sentinel|XPHB}, and {@feat Slasher|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Devourer
entries: Harnesses the power of the void to crush their enemies and feast on their souls.

subclassFeature.name: Havoc
entries: A brooding master of warglaives and the destructive power of Fel magic.

subclassFeature.name: Vengeance
entries: Embraces the demon within to incinerate enemies and protect their allies.

subclassFeature.name: Devourer Spells
entries: When you reach a Demon Hunter level specified in the Devourer Spells table, you thereafter always have the spells prepared.

subclassFeature.name: Havoc Spells
entries: When you reach a Demon Hunter level specified in the Havoc Spells table, you thereafter always have the spells listed prepared.

subclassFeature.name: Vengeance Spells
entries: When you reach a Demon Hunter level specified in the Vengeance Spells table, you thereafter always have the spells listed prepared.

subclassFeature.name: Soul Fragments
entries: You harvest the energy of souls to fuel some of your special powers. Whenever you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you gain a number of soul fragments equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of one fragment); each soul fragment is a Tiny object in the form of a crystal. These fragments last until you finish another {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, at which point they disintegrate. If you ever move more than 30 feet from a fragment, the fragment immediately teleports to you, appearing somewhere on your person.
If a soul fragment effect requires a saving throw, the DC equals your Demon Hunter spell save DC.

The number of soul fragments you gain when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} increases when you reach Demon Hunter levels 13 (Wisdom modifier plus one soul fragment) and 17 (Wisdom modifier plus two soul fragments).

entries.name: Using Soul Fragments
entries: You can use soul fragments in the following ways:

items.name: Double Jump
items.entry: You can expend one soul fragment to cast {@spell Feather Fall|XPHB} or {@spell Jump|XPHB} without expending a spell slot.

items.name: Soul Cleave
items.entry: Once on each of your turns, when you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action, you can expend one soul fragment and replace one of your attacks with a whirlwind of soul energy. Each creature in a 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes Psychic damage equal to 1d12 plus your Wisdom modifier, and you regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to your Wisdom modifier.

entries.name: Regaining Soul Fragments
entries: When an enemy you can see within 30 feet of you dies, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to regain one expended soul fragment.

subclassFeature.name: Spectral Sight
entries: You have {@sense Blindsight|XPHB} with a range of 10 feet.

subclassFeature.name: Torment
entries: A creature marked by your {@spell Hunter's Mark|XPHB} spell has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against targets other than you.

Additionally, once per turn when you hit a creature marked by your {@spell Hunter's Mark|XPHB} with an attack roll with a weapon or a Demon Hunter spell, you can impose one of the following effects on the target (your choice):

items.name: Aura of Pain
items.entry: The target subtracts {@dice 1d4} from the next saving throw it makes before the end of your next turn.

items.name: Chaos Strike
items.entry: The target takes an extra {@damage 1d8} Fire damage.

subclassFeature.name: Illidari Knowledge
entries: You gain new mastery over souls, granting you new ways to use {@subclassFeature Soul Fragments|Demon Hunter|WarcraftStreamlined|Devourer|WarcraftStreamlined|3}:

items.name: Disrupt
items.entry: You can expend two {@subclassFeature Soul Fragments|Demon Hunter|WarcraftStreamlined|Devourer|WarcraftStreamlined|3} to cast {@spell Counterspell|XPHB} in response to that spell's trigger, using your spellcasting ability.

items.name: Warglaive Mastery
items.entry: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can expend one {@subclassFeature Soul Fragments|Demon Hunter|WarcraftStreamlined|Devourer|WarcraftStreamlined|3||Soul Fragment} to cast {@spell Throw Glaive|WarcraftStreamlined} without expending a spell slot.

subclassFeature.name: Soul Shatter
entries: Your mastery of fel magic reaches new heights. When you use the Soul Cleave option of {@subclassFeature Soul Fragments|Demon Hunter|WarcraftStreamlined|Devourer|WarcraftStreamlined|3}, the damage increases to {@damage 2d12} plus your Wisdom modifier.

In addition, when you roll {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB}, you regain one {@subclassFeature Soul Fragments|Demon Hunter|WarcraftStreamlined|Devourer|WarcraftStreamlined|3||Soul Fragment} if you have none.

spell.name: Consume Soul
entries: You drain the essence from a creature within range, which makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 4d4} Force damage, and you gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to half the Force damage dealt. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage only.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d4} for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Soul Reap
entries: You cut a hole in the fabric of reality, sending a bolt of cosmic matter toward a creature in range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target, which gains no benefit from {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Half Cover} or {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Three-Quarters Cover}. On a hit, you deal {@damage 6d6} Force damage.

If you roll a 6 on a {@dice d6} for this spell, you can roll another {@dice d6} and add it to the damage. When you cast this spell, the maximum number of these d6s you can add to the spell's damage equals your spellcasting ability modifier.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d6} for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Metamorphosis

m.text: one soul fragment, which the spell consumes

entries: Uttering an incantation, you draw on fel or Void magic to transform yourself, taking on demonic features. You gain one of the following benefits of your choice until the spell ends:

items.name: Devourer
entries: When you roll damage for a spell, weapon, or feature that deals Force damage, you can treat any 1 or 2 on a damage die as a 3.

items.name: Havoc
entries: Whenever you hit a creature with an attack roll using a Melee weapon, the target takes an extra {@damage 1d6} Fire damage.

items.name: Vengeance
entries: You have a +2 bonus to AC, and your {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum and your current {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} increase by 5 for the spell's duration.

spell.name: Demon Spikes
entries: You surge with fel power and sprout hard, jagged spikes. You gain a +2 bonus to AC for the duration, and when a creature within 5 feet of you hits you with a melee attack roll, it takes 10 Piercing damage.

spell.name: Sigil of Flame
entries: You inscribe a sigil in the air that then appears on a creature you can see within range. The target makes a Constitution saving throw, taking {@damage 2d8} Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Whether or not the target fails its saving throw, it radiates heat in a 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from itself until the end of its next turn. At the start of the target's next turn, the target and each creature in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take {@damage 1d8} Fire damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage (both initial and later) increases by {@dice 1d8} for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Fiery Brand
entries: You magically place a fiery demonic symbol on a creature within range, which makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes {@damage 3d10} Fire damage and is cursed. While it remains cursed, you have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to all damage it deals. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage only.
A cursed creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on a success.

spell.name: Eye Beam
entries: You concentrate your magic into your eyes. When you cast the spell, and as a {@action Magic|XPHB} action on your subsequent turns for the duration, you can unleash a burst of fel magic. Each creature in a 15-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 3d6} Force damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d6} for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Throw Glaive
entries: You create a demonic warglaive and hurl it at a creature or object in range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 1d8} Slashing damage plus {@damage 1d8} Fire damage, and the glaive ricochets to a different target of your choice within 30 feet of the target. Make new attack and damage rolls against the new target.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The Fire damage increases by {@dice 1d8} for each spell slot level above 1. The glaive ricochets a maximum number of times equal to the level of the slot expended; a creature can be targeted only once by each casting of this spell.

spell.name: Infernal Strike
entries: You jump through the air without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks} and land in an unoccupied space within 30 feet. Each creature in a 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 2d6} Fire damage and has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against creatures other than you until the start of your next turn. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage only.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d6} for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Fel Rush
entries: Fiery fel magic surrounds you and grants you explosive speed. Until the end of your turn, your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} increases by 30 feet, and your movement doesn't provoke {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks}.

When you move within 5 feet of a creature or an object that isn't being worn or carried, it makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 2d6} Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature or object can take this damage only once per turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d6} for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Sigil of Chains
entries: A sigil appears at a point on the ground you can see within range, then erupts in a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere}. Each creature in the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 5d6} Force damage, is pulled up to 10 feet straight toward the sigil, and has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition until the end of your next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage, and its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is reduced by 10 feet until the end of your next turn.

spell.name: Collapsing Star
entries: You channel Void energy into a cataclysmic blast that fills a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point you can see within range. Each creature of your choice within the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} makes a Constitution saving throw, taking {@damage 4d12} Force damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

spell.name: Chaos Nova
entries: Chaos energy bursts out in a 20-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you. Each creature of your choice in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} takes {@damage 2d6} Force damage and must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition until the end of your next turn.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The paladin casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 14}):

trait.name: Devotion Aura
entries: While in a 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the paladin, the paladin and its allies have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws to avoid or end the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition, provided the paladin doesn't have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The paladin makes two Crusader Strike attacks.

action.name: Crusader Strike
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) Slashing damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) Radiant damage.

action.name: Judgment
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 6}, range 60 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 3d8}) Radiant damage, and the next attack roll against the target before the start of the paladin's next turn has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}.

action.name: Hammer of Justice {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 14}, one creature the paladin can see within 30 feet. {@actSaveFail} 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Radiant damage, and the target has the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition until the end of the paladin's next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Holy Light (3/Day)
entries: The paladin or one creature it can see within 30 feet regains 18 ({@dice 4d8}) {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

bonus.name: Divine Smite (3/Day)
